"""Planning probe: check CSV round trips for punctuation and newlines in names.

Probe command: python3 prototypes/export_csv_probe.py.
Result: prototypes/export_csv_probe.result.json.
"""
import csv
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path

rows = [["Tea, loose", "2"], ['Box "large"', "3"], ["Line\nbreak", "1"]]
stream = io.StringIO(newline="")
csv.writer(stream, lineterminator="\n").writerows(rows)
stream.seek(0)
assert list(csv.reader(stream)) == rows
Path(__file__).with_suffix(".result.json").write_text(
    json.dumps({"preserved": True, "rows": len(rows)}, sort_keys=True) + "\n"
)
print("All three names survived CSV writing and reading unchanged.")
